title: Dragging a free point with 10 dependents: the pointermove handler is about 0.6 ms slower than in v16.2 (frames unchanged)
detail: This was measured in pairs against v16.2 on one server and one headless Chrome, alternating old and new. The scene has a free point P with 5 circle3 circles through it and 5 meet points of those circles with a line, and 1/z in Y. The pointermove handler p95 was 1.8 ms in the new build and 1.2 ms in v16.2 (medians of 3 pairs; the per-run values do not overlap). An earlier best-of-2 run gave 1.6 vs 1.3 ms. rAF work (3.6 vs 3.5 ms) and frame p95 (16.7 ms in both) did not change, so this stays well inside BUDGET60. I did not pin down the cause. The likely candidates are the new per-row touchMeet() call, which runs piecesOf on both curves plus Constr.touchAt for every meet row whenever rows are described, and the longer pieceSig string. At 1 and 50 dependents the difference is lost in run-to-run noise.
evidence: <tmp> (P10 move_p95 best-of-2: new 1.6, old 1.3) and perf2.json (P10 move_p95 new [1.4, 1.8, 2.2], old [1.2, 1.1, 1.3]; work_p95 new [3.6, 3.6, 6.1], old [3.3, 3.5, 3.5]; delta_p95 16.7 to 16.8 for both). P1: move 0.8 vs 1.0, work 2.2 vs 2.2. P50 medians: move 20.6 vs 21.8, work 11.4 vs 11.5. G1: work 1.5 vs 1.1, move 5.5 vs 4.9. G10: work 1.4 vs 1.8, move 7.7 vs 13.5. G50: work 3.4 vs 3.9.
fix: Optional. In touchMeet(s), return false early unless one of the two curve shapes has def.op touch or tangent (a check on find(r.s).def.op before piecesOf and touchAt). Then v16.2-only scenes do no new work per row. Re-measure P10 after the change.

title: The desktop left panel is 60 px taller: Region from a formula, Shapes and Display start one tile row lower
detail: Two more Construct tiles add one 60 px row at every desktop size, in English and in Russian. The panel already scrolled in v16.2 (content 1275 px in an 846 px panel at 1440 × 900), so this adds no new scrollbar. Everything below Construct moves down 60 px, though. At 1440 × 900 the Display heading now sits at the bottom edge of the panel. Nothing covers the work area: canvas sizes and positions are the same at 1440 × 900, 1366 × 768, 1280 × 720 and 1024 × 768. The tablet rail at 768 × 1024 still fits without the cm-tight steps (970/970 in both builds; the Region tools label stays visible). The phone at 390 × 844 matches v16.2 on every measure taken.
evidence: <tmp> the left panel's scrollHeight/clientHeight goes from 1275/846 to 1335/846 (EN 1440 × 900) and from 1377 to 1437 (RU), and the same +60 px at 1366 × 768, 1280 × 720 and 1024 × 768. Tiles go from 22 to 24. canvasL and canvasR rects are identical. tab.json: at 768 × 1024 the rail shows 26 tools (24 in v16.2), the box is 970/970 and the label is shown. Screenshot: work/xv163/test/rreg_cdp/shots/lay_1440_new.png (removed at cleanup).
fix: None needed for the release. If the user wants Shapes higher, the Construct group could take 3 tiles per row on wide panels, or Construct could be collapsible.

title: Not a regression: with 50 dependents, a drag runs at 30 fps in v16.2 and in the new build alike
detail: The P50 scene has 25 circle3 circles through P (every other one a disc) and 25 meets, with 1/z in Y. Frame p95 is 33.3 to 33.4 ms in both builds. Dragging a glider with 50 dependents (G50) gives 50 to 67 ms in both. This predates the change and is unchanged by it. I list it only because BUDGET60 is the user's rule and the new tools make large construction scenes easier to build.
evidence: <tmp> and perf2.json: P50 delta_p95 new [33.4, 33.4, 33.4], old [50, 33.3, 33.3]; G50 delta_p95 new 50.1 and 66.7, old 66.7 and 66.7.
fix: Out of scope for v16.3. Track it separately (glider drags recompute in the pointermove handler; a region repaint for every disc dependent).
